reason: Candidate A provides a straightforward, physically plausible, and testable intervention (controlled aging) that remains within the baseline FeCoNi system and addresses the coercivity limitation by creating nanoscale precipitates for domain wall pinning. While Candidate B proposes a more dramatic composition change and potentially larger gains, it involves a more complex, two‐step intervention (major alloying plus RTA) that goes beyond a simple “derivative” of the single‐phase fcc FeCoNi baseline.
